promotion_context.name: InkClawAgent
promotion_context.job_to_be_done: turn multi-step knowledge work into a finished deliverable
promotion_context.pain_point: many capable tools or agents still leave coordination and handoff work to the user
promotion_context.differentiator: orchestrating research, writing, review and execution as one workflow
promotion_context.note: This is only the current example subject. The project now supports arbitrary brands/products/services/features/campaigns/people/ideas/keywords/tools.

briefs.topic: Humanoid robots move from spectacle toward useful work

sources.evidence_note: Reuters reported robot makers at the World Robot Conference emphasizing logistics, manufacturing and household work rather than only demonstrations.
Reuters framed the commercial test as moving beyond marathons/backflips toward customer value and productivity.

briefs.comparison_target: a fictional demo-first collection of specialist tools
briefs.comparison_selection_reason: The hotspot already contains a clean spectacle-vs-useful-work conflict. A fictional category proxy avoids inventing a defect about a named software competitor.
briefs.conflict: crowd-pleasing single tricks versus coordinated useful work
briefs.genre_treatment: real robotics expo shifting into a practical project room; fictional unbranded robots only

panels.scene: At a realistic robot expo, several fictional robots each perform one impressive trick while a project manager holds an unfinished deliverable checklist.
panels.caption: 都会一招，确实很帅。

panels.scene: The applause ends; separate boxes marked 搜 / 写 / 审 / 执行 still sit disconnected on a workbench.
panels.caption: 然后呢？谁把活串起来？

panels.scene: An original InkClawAgent control-room metaphor connects the specialist stations into one visible sequence.
panels.caption: InkClawAgent：别只看单项，开始协作。

panels.scene: The deliverable exits the workflow as a completed package while the demo stage is already preparing another stunt.
panels.caption: 会一招叫能力，能交付才叫结果。

briefs.topic: Niu Lai becomes a viral low-budget animation phenomenon

sources.evidence_note: FT reported the deliberately rough-looking low-budget Chinese animated film becoming a viral sensation and meme/remix source.

briefs.comparison_selection_reason: The trend's strongest transferable contrast is not a named rival but rough shipped work versus endless polish before feedback.
briefs.conflict: imperfect first version that enters culture versus perfect plan that never ships
briefs.genre_treatment: awkward handmade 3D comedy, intentionally simple materials and staging, without copying the film's characters

panels.scene: A rough original low-poly creator proudly uploads VERSION 1 while another team renders an ornate roadmap labeled FINAL V27.
panels.caption: 一个先发了，一个还在磨。

panels.scene: VERSION 1 starts receiving comment bubbles and useful feedback; FINAL V27 remains at 96% planning.
panels.caption: 有东西出来，才有东西能改。

panels.scene: InkClawAgent turns the work into DRAFT → REVIEW → REVISE → SHIP cards.
panels.caption: InkClawAgent：先跑起来，再迭代。

panels.scene: The revised output ships while the perfection team renames its roadmap FINAL_V28_REAL_FINAL.
panels.caption: 先交付，才有资格迭代。

risk_flags: do not use Niu Lai characters/title/poster/frames

briefs.topic: The Odyssey remains a major summer box-office conversation

sources.evidence_note: AP reported The Odyssey remained second at the North American box office and had passed $1.2 billion globally.

briefs.comparison_selection_reason: Use a real named competitor only after category/alternative research. Otherwise the cyclops can remain a fictional proxy for the pain point.
briefs.conflict: one-eyed cave obstacle versus clever escape
briefs.genre_treatment: original practical-feeling mythic cave, tactile costumes and warm torch/sunlight; public-domain Homeric archetypes only

panels.scene: An original enormous one-eyed cave guardian blocks the exit while workers carry unfinished tasks.
panels.caption: 问题不是没工具，是出口被堵了。

panels.scene: The guardian separates several useful task piles but no path connects them to the shore.
panels.caption: 每样都能做一点，结果还是出不了洞。

panels.scene: An original anonymous seafaring strategist representing InkClawAgent reroutes the group through a coordinated escape plan; no actor likeness and no copied film costume.
panels.caption: InkClawAgent：别硬耗，换条能出去的路。

panels.scene: The group reaches an original ship and open sea while the giant remains with disconnected piles.
panels.caption: 真破局，还得看 InkClawAgent。
